purpose: confirm Qwen3-1.7B 4-bit base runs the existing SFT script and measure real VRAM / s/step (no full run)

data.note: 871 is the teacher SOURCE (data/sources/teacher_distill_qwen3-8b.jsonl); the prepared F7 training set is 6437 rows (871 expanded). 6437/16=403 steps/epoch x4 = 1612 steps, matching F7 trainer_state max_steps=1612. Correction to the issue premise.

smoke.command: train.py --model unsloth/Qwen3-1.7B-unsloth-bnb-4bit --train-data data/train_distill.jsonl --val-data data/val_distill.jsonl --epochs 4 --max-steps 20 --lr 5e-5 --lr-scheduler cosine --warmup-ratio 0.05 --weight-decay 0.01 --batch-size 4 --grad-accum 4 --lora-r 32 --lora-alpha 64 --lora-dropout 0.025 --target-modules q_proj,k_proj,v_proj,o_proj,gate_proj,up_proj,down_proj --max-seq-len 2048 --chat-template-variant hardcoded-v1 --train-order shuffled --seed 42

extrapolation.basis: 4 epochs x ceil(6437/16) = 4 x 403 = 1612 (matches F7 trainer_state)
extrapolation.note: 20-step averages include unsloth first-step compile, which inflates per-step cost; the recorded 0.6B full 4-epoch run (~21.6 min) implies ~0.80 s/step steady-state, ~1.7x below the 20-step average. Applying the same correction to 1.7B gives ~44 min realistic; 75 min is a conservative upper bound. Either way ~2x the 0.6B run, proportional to the ~2.8x parameter increase.

go_reasons: runs with only the base_model swapped, same data/recipe, no code path changes beyond a --max-steps smoke knob
fits VRAM with ~4.0 GiB headroom at the F7 batch 4 / seq 2048 -- no batch/seq-len/grad-accum adjustment needed
extrapolated full run ~45-75 min (0.75-1.25 GPU-h), ~2x the 0.6B 4-epoch cost, proportional to parameter count
